title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, Saki...?
Is she looking for someone...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Morning, Hona♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep! Oh, Saki.
Haven't we told you that it's not safe to throw yourself at someone like that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. But I've been waiting for you, Hona♪
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...!
Y-Yeah! For now, let's go to your class♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Sure.
Class 1-B - Doorway

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, Saki, I'll see you during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Not so fast, Hona! I hope you're ready. Now, enter!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay...
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready, everyone!
Happy birthday, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: E-Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know what to say. Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We did it! Our surprise worked♪

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We even have some presents for you, Honami! Starting with some cookies!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We're not as great at baking as you are, Honami, but we made them ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! Oh, there's icing on them too! Hehe. They're made to look like animals. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I got you this, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow! What a colorful bouquet! Are these all different flowers?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ Everyone on the bouquet team all chose a flower they really liked for it♪

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We wanted to show just how much we appreciate everything you've done for us and ended up spending a lot of time learning about what each flower means.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, we put you through a lot during the choir recital and stuff so...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I'm sorry too. I feel awful about what I said to you then...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Me too... But you persevered and were willing to talk to all of us, and that really opened my eyes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That time, I was so afraid of what would happen if they all started to not like me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I believe that deciding to do something means you're choosing to give up on something else at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So you have to be ready to accept that people will dislike you for your decisions. That's normal.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is... Just do what you think is right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to say something before we begin.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I learned that kindness can come in many forms, and I was able to muster up the courage to say what I felt in front of everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They were willing to hear me out, and we were able to move forward, together...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I was able to find that courage... The courage to believe in them...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no! Honami, your eyes...!
Are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm okay, really...
I'm just so... Happy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for this wonderful time.
I hope we can all keep being friends.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Of course!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You have Emu to thank for that. She's the one who let me know about this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I felt that I needed to be here because of everything you did for us at the Seaside School!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Honami seems so happy. I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... But when we sent you to go get her, Saki, I was really worried about you spilling the beans.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you talking about?!
I... I was fine! Right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The more you deny it, the guiltier you look.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us, Shizuku. You too, Ichika, Saki, since we're in different classes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me. We're on the same committee and you've been taking such good care of Shii for me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So allow me to say this again.
Happy birthday, Honami! I hope you, Shii and I will remain friends for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, I hope so too!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're very welcome! Oh, also, did you know that Shii's the one who initially told me about this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because you'd torment me with your famous puppy dog eyes if I didn't invite you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I didn't know that.
Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Incidentally, Otori's the one who invited us here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I sure did! It was all me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I mean, it's a birthday party♪
You should be surrounded by lots and lots of friends♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting Ichika and everyone else here today, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ You're super welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we should take a picture before we forget! You too, Kohane, Saki... Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure, if you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki, Ichika, Shiho, Kohane, Emu, my classmates and even Shizuku... They all came to celebrate.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, Honami!
Stand next to me! Just to my right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Hona!
Stand next to me too! Just to my left!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like they want you right between them, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, be right there!
